dialogues.speaker: Nacker
dialogues.text: Of course. Here, I don't have to ponder over complex technical issues or constantly be forced to recall each and every step of painfully precise operations.

dialogues.speaker: Nacker
dialogues.text: More importantly, I don't have to deal with those short-sighted, arrogant fools.

dialogues.speaker: Nacker
dialogues.text: Based on those few facets alone, the Fortress of Meropide is vastly preferable to the Fontaine Research Institute.

dialogues.speaker: Nacker
dialogues.text: Oh, and I noticed that Jurieu fellow managed to build the Wingalet. He does seem to have some talent.

dialogues.speaker: Nacker
dialogues.text: Mr. Edwin's assistant has completed a significant undertaking, while Edwin himself remains where he started, empty-handed and frustrated.
